name: Marie Kelly
source: Marie Kelly is a lycan girl who attends Shōsei Gakuen and is in the same class as Kururu. She has a bright, energetic personality and is very cheerful by nature. Compared to Kururu, Marie comes across as slightly more boyish, with a straightforward and lively demeanor that stands out among her classmates.
